## How this work is cited

Passages inside Parerga und Paralipomena are identified by volume and essay or aphorism group. The corpus cites the same work under the German and the English form of its title. It is a two-volume collection of essays and aphorisms, and 'Aphorisms on the Wisdom of Life' is a section within the first volume rather than a separate work.

## The work in Arthur Schopenhauer’s thought

Arthur Schopenhauer (1788–1860) was a German philosopher of pessimism whose The World as Will and Representation fused Kantian phenomena with a blind metaphysical will. Largely ignored while Hegel dominated Berlin, he later won fame influencing artists and psychologists. [More on Arthur Schopenhauer](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/arthur-schopenhauer) .
